title: GPIR Structured Content Object
description: Common envelope shared by all 11 GPIR content types. See docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md for the design rationale and the rendering-path mapping for each type.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier, conventionally prefixed by type (e.g. country-uae, intel-cbuae-payment-token-2026).

renderingTarget.description: Repo-relative path to the existing static page this content object corresponds to, where one already exists. Not part of the prompt's required field list -- an explicit bridge field so an adapter always knows which existing rendering path a given object feeds. See docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md §5.

typeSpecific.description: Fields specific to this object's contentType. Shape varies by type -- see docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md §3.

evidence.description: Research provenance -- only present where there is enough real, verifiable information to justify it. See docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md §8. Absent/null is a valid, expected state, not a gap to fill by guessing.

sourceName.description: The specific named publication/document, distinct from the organisation that issued it.

evidenceType.description: The nature of THIS object's core claim. Where a single object mixes a sourced fact with FINTECHOISIS's own interpretive commentary (common for intelligence records), this classifies the object's primary claim and `analysisFields` names which specific fields are FINTECHOISIS's own analysis layered on top.

referencePeriod.description: The period the underlying data/claim applies to, where that's a real, bounded period backed by evidence -- left null rather than guessed when no such period is evidenced.

verificationStatus.description: Reuses the exact vocabulary assets/js/trust-engine.js and scripts/generate-intelligence-pages.js's evaluateSource() already compute -- not a competing classification. Set from that system's real, already-computed output, never guessed independently.

analysisFields.description: Names of this object's own fields (e.g. "description") that are FINTECHOISIS's own analysis/commentary rather than sourced fact, so a presentation component can visually separate the two without needing a second content object.

versionInfo.description: Lightweight content-lifecycle metadata, distinct from git history (which remains the record of every edit). Tracks only whether this object has been superseded by, or itself supersedes, another content object -- for future intelligence processing (e.g. "show me only the current version of X"), not a full changelog.

supersedes.description: id of an older content object this one replaces, if any.

supersededBy.description: id of a newer content object that replaces this one, if any.

relationships.description: Typed, directed edges to other content objects. See docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md §7 for the controlled vocabulary and the reverse-index mechanism that derives inbound edges without hand-duplicating them.
